section_summary: This section comprises records concerning natural resources and agricultural programs under the Allied Occupation of Japan in late 1949. It begins with the concluding pages of an earlier report detailing Japanese land reform, agricultural cooperatives, and crop and livestock insurance. It is followed by Despatch No. 893 from the Office of the U.S. Political Adviser in Tokyo transmitting the complete report 'Mission and Accomplishments of the Occupation in the Natural Resources Field' (September 26, 1949) prepared by GHQ SCAP's Natural Resources Section, which surveys policies and progress across agriculture, fisheries, wildlife, forestry, and mining.

subfiles.about: Concluding portion of an Occupation report on Japanese agricultural programs, discussing land reform, cooperatives, and agricultural insurance.
subfiles.from: Natural Resources Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: Concludes an analysis of land reform transfers, democratic agricultural cooperatives, and crop and livestock insurance systems under the Allied Occupation.
subfiles.title: Japanese Agricultural Programs Under the Occupation

subfiles.about: Covering despatch transmitting four copies of a SCAP Natural Resources Section report to the Department of State.
subfiles.from: Office of the U.S. Political Adviser for Japan, Tokyo
subfiles.summary: Transmits four copies of the SCAP report on Occupation accomplishments in natural resources to the State Department.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 893: Transmission of Publication on Mission and Accomplishments of the Occupation in the Natural Resources Field

subfiles.about: Comprehensive report evaluating Japan's natural resources and reviewing SCAP achievements across agriculture, fisheries, wildlife, forestry, and mining.
subfiles.from: Natural Resources Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: This report provides an extensive survey of Japanese natural resources and reviews SCAP policies and programs designed to maximize domestic production and promote democratic economic reforms. It covers agricultural initiatives including land reform, fertilizer allocation, cooperatives, and crop reporting, as well as the rehabilitation of the fishing industry and wildlife conservation. Additionally, it examines critical forest depletion alongside reforestation efforts, and details mining, petroleum exploration, pyrite production, and mine safety improvements.
subfiles.title: Mission and Accomplishments of the Occupation in the Natural Resources Field
